# VoxFusion

A local-first, offline-capable voice transcription desktop app. All transcription happens on-device using a Whisper V3 Large Turbo model — no servers, no accounts, no internet required after first-time model download.

## Packages

| Package                    | Description              | Stack                                                           |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `@voxfusion/app`           | Desktop application      | Tauri v2, SolidJS, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, whisper-rs, SQLite |
| `@voxfusion/marketingsite` | Public marketing website | Astro, TypeScript, Wrangler                                     |

## Prerequisites

- [Bun](https://bun.sh/) (v1.0+)
- [Rust](https://rustup.rs/) (for Tauri development)
- [CMake](https://cmake.org/) (required to build whisper-rs; on macOS: `brew install cmake`)

## Getting Started

### Install dependencies

```bash
bun install
```

### Development

```bash
bun run dev
```

Or run the app directly:

```bash
bun run --filter @voxfusion/app dev
```

Or run the marketing site directly:

```bash
bun run --filter @voxfusion/marketingsite dev
```

### Tauri Desktop App

For full Tauri development with the native window:

```bash
cd packages/app
bun run tauri:dev
```

### Build

```bash
bun run build
```

## How it works

On first launch, the app walks the user through onboarding:

1. Microphone permission
2. Accessibility permission (for typing transcribed text into other apps)
3. Microphone device selection
4. Hotkey configuration
5. **Whisper model download** (~1.5 GB, one-time, requires internet)
6. Try-it-out / learning step
7. Completion

After onboarding, the app is fully offline. All transcriptions and dictionary words are stored locally in a SQLite database under the app's data directory.

## Linting & Formatting

This project uses [Biome](https://biomejs.dev/) for linting and formatting.

```bash
bun run check        # lint + format
bun run check:fix    # auto-fix
bun run format       # format only
bun run lint         # lint only
bun run typecheck    # TypeScript type checking
```

## Contributing

VoxFusion is released under the MIT license. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
for setup instructions, pull request guidelines, and privacy expectations for
contributions.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

5	## Cursor Cloud specific instructions
6	
7	### Overview
8	
9	VoxFusion is a Bun/Turborepo monorepo with two packages:
10	
11	- `@voxfusion/app` — Tauri v2 desktop app (SolidJS + Rust). **macOS-only** for full native builds.
12	- `@voxfusion/marketingsite` — Astro static marketing website.
13	
14	### Running services
15	
16	| Service | Command | Port | Notes |
17	|---------|---------|------|-------|
18	| App frontend (Vite) | `cd packages/app && bunx vite --host 0.0.0.0` | 1420 | SolidJS UI only; Tauri IPC unavailable in standalone browser mode |
19	| Marketing site (Astro) | `cd packages/marketingsite && bun run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0` | 4321 | Fully functional on Linux |
20	| Full Tauri app | `cd packages/app && bun run tauri:dev` | — | Requires macOS (Metal, accessibility, tray) |
21	
22	### Lint / typecheck / build
23	
24	Standard commands documented in `README.md` scripts section. Key notes:
25	
26	- `bun run check` — runs Biome across the whole repo. The marketing site has pre-existing lint warnings (unused imports).
27	- `bun run --filter @voxfusion/app typecheck` — passes clean.
28	- `bun run --filter @voxfusion/marketingsite typecheck` — runs `astro check` which currently reports ~1098 errors because it type-checks the app's SolidJS TSX files via workspace references. This is a pre-existing issue.
29	- `bunx vite build` (from `packages/app`) — builds the frontend successfully on Linux.
30	- `bun run build` (from `packages/marketingsite`) — builds all 6 static pages successfully.
31	
32	### Rust / Tauri backend on Linux
33	
34	`cargo check` in `packages/app/src-tauri` **will fail** on Linux because:
35	
36	1. `whisper-rs` is compiled with `features = ["metal"]` which requires macOS Metal framework.
37	2. Several dependencies (`core-graphics`, `objc2`, `objc2-app-kit`) are macOS-only.
38	
39	For frontend-only development on Linux, use the Vite dev server directly (`bunx vite`). The Rust backend requires macOS for compilation.
40	
41	### System dependencies (Linux)
42	
43	Required for `cargo check` to proceed as far as possible (before the macOS-specific failure):
44	
45	```
46	libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf libxdo-dev libssl-dev libasound2-dev
47	```
48	
49	Also requires `libstdc++.so` symlink: `sudo ln -sf /usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/13/libstdc++.so /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so`
50	
51	### System dependencies (macOS)
52	
53	Required for `bun dev` / Tauri builds (whisper-rs-sys uses CMake to compile whisper.cpp):
54	
55	```
56	brew install cmake
57	```
58	
59	Without CMake, `bun dev` fails during `whisper-rs-sys` with `is cmake not installed?`.
60

## Cursor Cloud specific instructions

### Overview

VoxFusion is a Bun/Turborepo monorepo with two packages:

- `@voxfusion/app` — Tauri v2 desktop app (SolidJS + Rust). **macOS-only** for full native builds.
- `@voxfusion/marketingsite` — Astro static marketing website.

### Running services

| Service | Command | Port | Notes |
|---------|---------|------|-------|
| App frontend (Vite) | `cd packages/app && bunx vite --host 0.0.0.0` | 1420 | SolidJS UI only; Tauri IPC unavailable in standalone browser mode |
| Marketing site (Astro) | `cd packages/marketingsite && bun run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0` | 4321 | Fully functional on Linux |
| Full Tauri app | `cd packages/app && bun run tauri:dev` | — | Requires macOS (Metal, accessibility, tray) |

### Lint / typecheck / build

Standard commands documented in `README.md` scripts section. Key notes:

- `bun run check` — runs Biome across the whole repo. The marketing site has pre-existing lint warnings (unused imports).
- `bun run --filter @voxfusion/app typecheck` — passes clean.
- `bun run --filter @voxfusion/marketingsite typecheck` — runs `astro check` which currently reports ~1098 errors because it type-checks the app's SolidJS TSX files via workspace references. This is a pre-existing issue.
- `bunx vite build` (from `packages/app`) — builds the frontend successfully on Linux.
- `bun run build` (from `packages/marketingsite`) — builds all 6 static pages successfully.

### Rust / Tauri backend on Linux

`cargo check` in `packages/app/src-tauri` **will fail** on Linux because:

1. `whisper-rs` is compiled with `features = ["metal"]` which requires macOS Metal framework.
2. Several dependencies (`core-graphics`, `objc2`, `objc2-app-kit`) are macOS-only.

For frontend-only development on Linux, use the Vite dev server directly (`bunx vite`). The Rust backend requires macOS for compilation.

### System dependencies (Linux)

Required for `cargo check` to proceed as far as possible (before the macOS-specific failure):

```
libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf libxdo-dev libssl-dev libasound2-dev
```

Also requires `libstdc++.so` symlink: `sudo ln -sf /usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/13/libstdc++.so /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so`

### System dependencies (macOS)

Required for `bun dev` / Tauri builds (whisper-rs-sys uses CMake to compile whisper.cpp):

```
brew install cmake
```

Without CMake, `bun dev` fails during `whisper-rs-sys` with `is cmake not installed?`.

### Gotchas

- Rust toolchain must be ≥1.85 (edition 2024 support). Run `rustup update stable && rustup default stable`.
- The app frontend at localhost:1420 shows a loading spinner and never progresses in a browser because it waits for the Tauri IPC bridge. This is expected; UI component development still works by navigating directly to routes.
- `turbo dev` runs both packages' dev scripts concurrently (uses TUI mode).

  LEGACY_RELEASES_REPO: gregor-tokarev/voxfusion-releases

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: '1.3.3'

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: aarch64-apple-darwin,x86_64-apple-darwin

      - name: Rust cache
        uses: swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: './packages/app/src-tauri -> target'
          shared-key: 'release-build'
          save-if: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Sync version from git tag
        run: |
          VERSION=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}
          echo "Setting version to $VERSION"
          cd packages/app/src-tauri
          jq --arg v "$VERSION" '.version = $v' tauri.conf.json > tmp.json && mv tmp.json tauri.conf.json
          echo "Updated tauri.conf.json:"
          grep '"version"' tauri.conf.json

      - name: Import Apple Developer Certificate
        env:
          APPLE_CERTIFICATE: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE }}
          APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          echo $APPLE_CERTIFICATE | base64 --decode > certificate.p12
          security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build.keychain
          security default-keychain -s build.keychain
          security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build.keychain
          security set-keychain-settings -t 3600 -u build.keychain
          security import certificate.p12 -k build.keychain -P "$APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" -T /usr/bin/codesign
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build.keychain
          security find-identity -v -p codesigning build.keychain

      - name: Verify Certificate
        run: |
          CERT_INFO=$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning build.keychain | grep "Developer ID Application")
          CERT_ID=$(echo "$CERT_INFO" | awk -F'"' '{print $2}')

          echo "Certificate imported: $CERT_ID"

          APPLE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}

          for secret_name in APPLE_ID APPLE_PASSWORD APPLE_TEAM_ID; do
            if [ -z "${!secret_name}" ]; then
              echo "::error::Missing GitHub secret: $secret_name"

            fi

          VITE_API_URL: https://voxfusion-production.up.railway.app

          APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY: ${{ env.CERT_ID }}
          APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}
          APPLE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
          MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: "11.0"
        run: |
          bun run tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
          bun run tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin

      - name: Find build artifacts
        id: artifacts
        run: |
          echo "Searching for artifacts..."

          ARM_DMG_PATH=$(find packages/app/src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-darwin -name "*.dmg" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$ARM_DMG_PATH" ]; then
            echo "Error: No Apple Silicon DMG file found"
            find packages/app/src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-darwin -type f -name "*.dmg" || true
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Found Apple Silicon DMG: $ARM_DMG_PATH"
          echo "ARM_DMG_PATH=$ARM_DMG_PATH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          INTEL_DMG_PATH=$(find packages/app/src-tauri/target/x86_64-apple-darwin -name "*.dmg" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$INTEL_DMG_PATH" ]; then
            echo "Error: No Intel DMG file found"
            find packages/app/src-tauri/target/x86_64-apple-darwin -type f -name "*.dmg" || true
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Found Intel DMG: $INTEL_DMG_PATH"
          echo "INTEL_DMG_PATH=$INTEL_DMG_PATH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          ARM_TARBALL_PATH=$(find packages/app/src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-darwin -name "*.app.tar.gz" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$ARM_TARBALL_PATH" ]; then
            echo "Error: No Apple Silicon .app.tar.gz file found"
            find packages/app/src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-darwin -type f -name "*.tar.gz" || true
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Found Apple Silicon tarball: $ARM_TARBALL_PATH"
          echo "ARM_TARBALL_PATH=$ARM_TARBALL_PATH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          INTEL_TARBALL_PATH=$(find packages/app/src-tauri/target/x86_64-apple-darwin -name "*.app.tar.gz" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$INTEL_TARBALL_PATH" ]; then
            echo "Error: No Intel .app.tar.gz file found"
            find packages/app/src-tauri/target/x86_64-apple-darwin -type f -name "*.tar.gz" || true
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Found Intel tarball: $INTEL_TARBALL_PATH"
          echo "INTEL_TARBALL_PATH=$INTEL_TARBALL_PATH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          ARM_SIG_FILE="${ARM_TARBALL_PATH}.sig"
          if [ -f "$ARM_SIG_FILE" ]; then
            echo "Found Apple Silicon signature file: $ARM_SIG_FILE"
            cat "$ARM_SIG_FILE"
          else
            echo "Error: No Apple Silicon signature file found at $ARM_SIG_FILE"
            find packages/app/src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-darwin -name "*.sig" -type f || true
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "ARM_SIG_FILE=$ARM_SIG_FILE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          INTEL_SIG_FILE="${INTEL_TARBALL_PATH}.sig"
          if [ -f "$INTEL_SIG_FILE" ]; then
            echo "Found Intel signature file: $INTEL_SIG_FILE"
            cat "$INTEL_SIG_FILE"
          else
            echo "Error: No Intel signature file found at $INTEL_SIG_FILE"
            find packages/app/src-tauri/target/x86_64-apple-darwin -name "*.sig" -type f || true
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "INTEL_SIG_FILE=$INTEL_SIG_FILE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Notarize macOS DMGs
        env:
          APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}
          APPLE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          notarize_dmg() {
            local dmg_path="$1"

            echo "Submitting DMG for notarization: $dmg_path"
            xcrun notarytool submit "$dmg_path" \
              --apple-id "$APPLE_ID" \
              --password "$APPLE_PASSWORD" \
              --team-id "$APPLE_TEAM_ID" \
              --wait

            echo "Stapling notarization ticket to DMG: $dmg_path"
            xcrun stapler staple "$dmg_path"
            xcrun stapler validate "$dmg_path"
          }

          notarize_dmg "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.ARM_DMG_PATH }}"
          notarize_dmg "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.INTEL_DMG_PATH }}"

      - name: Verify macOS signing and notarization
        run: |
          verify_dmg() {
            local dmg_path="$1"
            local assessment

            echo "Verifying DMG signature and Gatekeeper assessment: $dmg_path"
            if ! assessment=$(spctl -a -vvv -t open --context context:primary-signature "$dmg_path" 2>&1); then
              echo "$assessment"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "$assessment"
            if echo "$assessment" | grep -q "Unnotarized Developer ID"; then
              echo "Error: DMG is signed but not notarized: $dmg_path"
              exit 1
            fi
          }

          verify_app_tarball() {
            local tarball_path="$1"
            local tmp_dir
            tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d)

            echo "Verifying app bundle in updater tarball: $tarball_path"
            tar -xzf "$tarball_path" -C "$tmp_dir"

            local app_path
            app_path=$(find "$tmp_dir" -maxdepth 2 -name "*.app" -type d | head -1)
            if [ -z "$app_path" ]; then
              echo "Error: No .app bundle found in $tarball_path"
              find "$tmp_dir" -maxdepth 3 -print
              exit 1
            fi

            codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$app_path"
            xcrun stapler validate "$app_path"
            spctl -a -vvv -t exec "$app_path"
          }

          verify_dmg "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.ARM_DMG_PATH }}"
          verify_dmg "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.INTEL_DMG_PATH }}"
          verify_app_tarball "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.ARM_TARBALL_PATH }}"
          verify_app_tarball "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.INTEL_TARBALL_PATH }}"

      - name: Prepare artifacts for upload
        run: |
          mkdir -p release-artifacts
          cp "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.ARM_DMG_PATH }}" release-artifacts/VoxFusion.dmg
          cp "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.ARM_DMG_PATH }}" release-artifacts/VoxFusion-latest.dmg
          cp "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.ARM_TARBALL_PATH }}" release-artifacts/VoxFusion.app.tar.gz
          cp "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.ARM_SIG_FILE }}" release-artifacts/VoxFusion.app.tar.gz.sig
          cp "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.INTEL_DMG_PATH }}" release-artifacts/VoxFusion-intel.dmg
          cp "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.INTEL_DMG_PATH }}" release-artifacts/VoxFusion-latest-intel.dmg
          cp "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.INTEL_TARBALL_PATH }}" release-artifacts/VoxFusion-intel.app.tar.gz
          cp "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.INTEL_SIG_FILE }}" release-artifacts/VoxFusion-intel.app.tar.gz.sig

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-artifacts
          path: release-artifacts/

  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-artifacts
          path: release-artifacts/

      - name: Get version from tag
        id: version
        run: echo "VERSION=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Generate updater manifests
        run: |
          VERSION=${{ steps.version.outputs.VERSION }}
          ARM_SIGNATURE=$(cat release-artifacts/VoxFusion.app.tar.gz.sig)
          INTEL_SIGNATURE=$(cat release-artifacts/VoxFusion-intel.app.tar.gz.sig)

          create_manifest() {
            local output="$1"
            local arm_download_url="$2"
            local intel_download_url="$3"

            jq -n \
              --arg version "$VERSION" \
              --arg arm_signature "$ARM_SIGNATURE" \
              --arg intel_signature "$INTEL_SIGNATURE" \
              --arg arm_url "$arm_download_url" \
              --arg intel_url "$intel_download_url" \
              --arg pub_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
              '{
                version: $version,
                notes: "See release notes on GitHub",
                pub_date: $pub_date,
                platforms: {
                  "darwin-aarch64": { signature: $arm_signature, url: $arm_url },
                  "darwin-x86_64": { signature: $intel_signature, url: $intel_url }
                }
              }' > "$output"
          }

          create_manifest \
            latest-current.json \
            "https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/download/${{ github.ref_name }}/VoxFusion.app.tar.gz" \
            "https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/download/${{ github.ref_name }}/VoxFusion-intel.app.tar.gz"
          create_manifest \
            latest-legacy.json \
            "https://github.com/${{ env.LEGACY_RELEASES_REPO }}/releases/download/${{ github.ref_name }}/VoxFusion.app.tar.gz" \
            "https://github.com/${{ env.LEGACY_RELEASES_REPO }}/releases/download/${{ github.ref_name }}/VoxFusion-intel.app.tar.gz"

          echo "Created current repository updater manifest:"
          cat latest-current.json
          echo "Created legacy releases repository updater manifest:"
          cat latest-legacy.json

      - name: Prepare current repository manifest
        run: cp latest-current.json latest.json

      - name: Create release in current repository
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          name: VoxFusion ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body: |
            ## VoxFusion ${{ github.ref_name }}

            ### Download
            Download the DMG file below and drag VoxFusion to your Applications folder.

            This release is signed and notarized by Apple.

            ---
            Existing users will receive this update automatically.
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          files: |
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion.dmg
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion-latest.dmg
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion-intel.dmg
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion-latest-intel.dmg
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion.app.tar.gz
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion-intel.app.tar.gz
            latest.json

      - name: Prepare legacy releases repository manifest
        run: cp latest-legacy.json latest.json

      - name: Create release in legacy releases repository
        id: legacy_release
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASES_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: ${{ env.LEGACY_RELEASES_REPO }}
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          name: VoxFusion ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body: |
            ## VoxFusion ${{ github.ref_name }}

            ### Download
            Download the DMG file below and drag VoxFusion to your Applications folder.

            This release is signed and notarized by Apple.

            ---
            Existing users will receive this update automatically.
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          files: |
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion.dmg
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion-latest.dmg
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion-intel.dmg
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion-latest-intel.dmg
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion.app.tar.gz
            release-artifacts/VoxFusion-intel.app.tar.gz
            latest.json

      - name: Warn if legacy releases repository publish failed
        if: steps.legacy_release.outcome == 'failure'
        run: |
          echo "::warning::Publishing to ${{ env.LEGACY_RELEASES_REPO }} failed. The primary release in ${{ github.repository }} was already created successfully. Check RELEASES_GITHUB_TOKEN if the legacy mirror is still required."

# Contributing to VoxFusion

Thanks for helping improve VoxFusion. This project is a local-first desktop
transcription app built with Tauri, SolidJS, TypeScript, Rust, SQLite, and
Whisper.

## Project Priorities

- Keep transcription local-first and offline after the first model download.
- Preserve user privacy: avoid sending transcript, audio, dictionary, or device
  data to third-party services.
- Prefer small, reviewable changes over broad rewrites.
- Match the existing code style and user interface patterns.

## Development Setup

Install the required tools:

- [Bun](https://bun.sh/) 1.3.3 or newer
- [Rust](https://rustup.rs/)

```sh
bun install

cd packages/app
bun run tauri:dev

bun run dev

bun run check
bun run typecheck
bun run build

```sh
bun run --filter @voxfusion/app typecheck
bun run --filter @voxfusion/app lint

bun run --filter @voxfusion/marketingsite lint
```

cd packages/app/src-tauri

- `packages/app/src-tauri/src`: Rust handlers, listeners, and Tauri setup.
- `packages/marketingsite/src`: Astro marketing site.
- `.github/workflows`: release automation.

  pull request.

Do not add telemetry for transcripts, dictionary words, raw audio, selected
microphone names, file paths, or hotkey values. Analytics events should be
coarse-grained and should not include personal content.

By contributing, you agree that your contributions are licensed under the MIT
license used by this repository.

# on-device (handlers::parakeet). whisper-rs cannot run Parakeet (a TDT
# transducer), so transcription is delegated to CrispStrobe/CrispASR — the
# ggml/Metal C++ runtime the cstr/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-GGUF files target.
#
# The result (binary + its ggml/crispasr dylibs) is installed into the app's
# data dir under `bin/`, which handlers::parakeet::resolve_binary discovers at
# runtime. Re-run this after pulling a new engine version.
#
# Usage: packages/app/scripts/build-parakeet-engine.sh [dest_bin_dir]
# Default dest: ~/Library/Application Support/io.voxfusion.app/bin  (macOS)
set -euo pipefail

REPO_URL="https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispASR"
WORK_DIR="${PARAKEET_BUILD_DIR:-/tmp/CrispASR}"
DEST_DIR="${1:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/io.voxfusion.app/bin}"

echo "==> Cloning $REPO_URL into $WORK_DIR"
rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
git clone --depth 1 "$REPO_URL" "$WORK_DIR"

echo "==> Configuring (Release; tests/server off)"
cmake -S "$WORK_DIR" -B "$WORK_DIR/build" \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCRISPASR_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
  -DCRISPASR_BUILD_SERVER=OFF

echo "==> Building crispasr CLI (this is a large compile)"
cmake --build "$WORK_DIR/build" -j --target crispasr-cli

echo "==> Installing engine into: $DEST_DIR"
mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
cp "$WORK_DIR/build/bin/crispasr" "$DEST_DIR/"
# The CLI is a thin shell over @rpath dylibs; collect the closure it needs.
cp "$WORK_DIR/build/src/libcrispasr.1.dylib" "$DEST_DIR/"
cp "$WORK_DIR/build/ggml/src/libggml.0.dylib" "$DEST_DIR/"
cp "$WORK_DIR/build/ggml/src/libggml-base.0.dylib" "$DEST_DIR/"
cp "$WORK_DIR/build/ggml/src/libggml-cpu.0.dylib" "$DEST_DIR/"
cp "$WORK_DIR/build/ggml/src/ggml-metal/libggml-metal.0.dylib" "$DEST_DIR/"
cp "$WORK_DIR/build/ggml/src/ggml-blas/libggml-blas.0.dylib" "$DEST_DIR/"

# Resolve @rpath against each file's own directory so the folder is portable
# (independent of the build tree). Idempotent: ignore "already present" errors.
for f in crispasr libcrispasr.1.dylib libggml.0.dylib libggml-base.0.dylib \
         libggml-cpu.0.dylib libggml-metal.0.dylib libggml-blas.0.dylib; do
  install_name_tool -add_rpath @loader_path "$DEST_DIR/$f" 2>/dev/null || true
done
